prerequisites: Knowledge of symbols, specific graphics, electrical diagrams

learning_outcomes.text: Proper implementation of specific fundamental knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry, in the field of electrical engineering
Use of fundamental concepts of computer science and information technology
Use of fundamental knowledge of electrotechnics
Design of electrical systems and their components
Design and coordination of experiments and tests
Diagnosis, troubleshooting and maintenance of electrical systems and components
Identification of the objectives to be achieved, available resources, conditions to complete them, working stages, working times, associated deadlines and risks
Identification of the roles and responsibilities in a multidisciplinary team and use of relationship and effective working techniques in the team

Effective use of information and communication sources and assisted professional training (Internet portals, specialized software applications, databases, online courses etc.) both in Romanian and in a foreign language.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: The sides and structure of the production process. Preparation of the manufacture of an electrotechnical product; Defining the production process Breakdown by component elements. Their analysis. Defining the preparation cycle for the manufacture of an electrical product. Types of production. Characteristics; specific topics are requested.
Structure of execution projects. The structure of an EP. Analysis of the component elements;
Technology of execution of electrical diagrams. Technologies for the realization of developed electrical diagrams. Node numbering principle, Clamps principle, Mixed principle;
Transformer technology. Methodology for calculating low power transformers. Low power transformer design technology. Design sizes. Sizes to choose from. Sizes to be calculated. Verification stage.

Magnetic core technology for rotary electric machines. Materials for magnetic cores. Sheet metal cutting technology. Stamping technology. Example of technological flow for making sheets at the cores of rotary electric machines. Packaging technology;

Magnetic core technology for transformers and electrical appliances. Powdered magnetic core technology. Technology for making cores for transformers. Packaging methods. Technology for making sintered cores;

Winding technology. Used materials. Execution of windings. Technology for making Cu conductors, Soft winding technology. Technology for making concentrated and bucket windings from profiled conductor;
Impregnation, coating and compounding. Impregnation materials. Coil impregnation and compounding technologies;
Technology of contact elements and current paths. Connection element technology. Current path technology;
Brush and brush manufacturing technology. Materials for electric brushes. Classification of electric brushes. Use. Electric brush formatting technology;
Contact manufacturing technology for electrical appliances. Contact materials. Disruptive phenomena in electrical contacts. Technology for making electrical contacts;

Printed wiring design technology. Printed circuit technology. Obtaining the semi-finished product for printed circuits. Technological elements for making double layer wiring. Exemplification. Technological elements for making multilayer wiring;
Printed wiring execution technology. Bonding technologies on printed wiring. Used devices. Wave soldering technologies. Modern ultrasonic welding technologies;
Modern trends in electrical technologies. Analyzing current trends in electrical technologies for making electrical products.
Introduction. Presentation of the laboratory and laboratory works. Technical norms of work safety, fire prevention and extinguishing;
The technology of execution of the schemes according to the principle of nodes. Correct marking of nodes, equipment and references from one board to another;
Calculation of low power transformers;
Study of magnetic cores for rotary electric machines; Study of winding execution technology;
Electric brush repair technology;
Printed wiring design and execution technology;
Technology of gluing components on printed wiring.
assessment_rules: The final mark (N) is calculated as N = 0.50VP + 0.50LT, where VP is Periodic Verification and LT is Laboratory. The Laboratory (LF) component is calculated as LF = 0.450L + 0.05R, where L is Laboratory and R is Report/synthesis material. To obtain credits, N, LF, and R must all be greater than or equal to 5. The course exam consists of 3 topics, each subject must be treated for at least grade 5 to pass. All laboratory work must be performed to enter the exam, with only one remaining laboratory recovery allowed in the last week.
